text: Before this year ends, there's one number that decides how your next one begins.
Take your birth month and your birth day.
Add every digit, plus two, zero, two, and seven.
Keep adding until only one digit is left.
A nine closes a chapter for good.
But the number only tells you the theme, not what's walking through the door.
In my stories, three cards are waiting to show you what it's bringing.
